title_en: Ali (peace be upon him) and Fighting over Esoteric Interpretation - Part 43
description_en: المرجعية والخلافة بعد الرسول(ص) 1 / ربيع الثاني /1433
summary: In this lecture, His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari addresses the theme of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and the conflicts related to esoteric interpretation (ta'wil).
series_en: Muṭarahat fi al-Aqida - Al-Marja'iyya wal-Khilafa ba'd al-Rasul
